data.name: [Stock] Order Completed - Finalize Stock
data.description: When an order is completed: creates the COD transaction, moves quantity from reserved to sold, and marks the listing sold once fully allocated (amount - reserved - sold <= 0). Skips rentals (date-overlap availability) and swaps ([Swap] flows).

data.name: [Reviews] Review Created - Update User Rating
data.description: On review create: recalculates the reviewed user’s rating and total_reviews.

data.name: [Notify] New Review - Notify Target User
data.description: Notifies a user when they receive a new review.

data.name: [Business] New Store Created - Notify Swibba Managers
data.description: When a new store is created (onboarding or post-approval), notifies all Swibba managers with a deep link to the stores page.

data.name: [Stock] Quantity Updated - Restore Listing Status
data.description: When a business listing is updated while its status is reserved/sold/rented/swapped but counters show free capacity (amount - reserved - sold > 0), restores it to published - so raising stock automatically republishes a sold-out product. Skips individual sellers.

data.name: [Business] Verification Decision - Notify Owner
data.description: Notifies the business owner when their business verification is approved or rejected.

data.name: [Store Team] Shipping Update → Notify Managers
data.description: Additive: notifies store managers (business_team) on shipping create/update. Does not modify existing flows.

data.name: [Deprecated] New Manager Message - First Message Only
data.description: DEPRECATED (inactive) - replaced by the unified new-message flow. Notified users only on the first message of a manager conversation.

data.name: [Notify] New Offer - Notify Listing Owner
data.description: Notifies the listing owner when someone makes an offer.

data.name: [Business] Category Request - Notify Swibba Managers
data.description: When a business updates operating_categories, notifies Swibba managers of NEW pending categories via [Helper] Send to Managers.

data.name: [Stock] Offer Created - Reserve Stock
data.description: Filter hook on listing_offers.create: rejects the offer when available stock (amount - reserved - sold) < requested quantity; otherwise increments reserved_quantity and sets listing status to reserved when nothing is left. Skips rentals, swaps, and untracked listings.

data.name: [Orders] Offer Accepted - Create Order
data.description: Automatically creates an order when a listing offer is accepted. Handles purchase, rental, and swap offers.

data.name: [SEO] Brand Meta Tags - Auto Generate
data.description: Creates SEO meta tags automatically when a new brand is created.

data.name: [Reviews] Brand Rating - Recalculate
data.description: On review create/update with a brand_id: recalculates the brand’s rating and total_reviews.

data.name: [Helper] Send to Managers
data.description: Reusable helper: sends notification to ALL active Swibba managers. Input: { subject, message, collection?, item? }

data.name: [Notify] Listing Approved/Rejected - Notify Owner
data.description: Notifies the listing owner when their listing is approved (published) or rejected.

data.name: [Helper] Notify Store Team
data.description: Reusable: given { business_id, store_id?, owner_id?, actor_id?, exclude_ids?, subject, message, category, ... , translations }, notifies all active store managers (business_team) of that store/business. Owner & actor excluded; deduped.

data.name: [Notify] Shipping Status Changed - Notify Users
data.description: Notifies buyers, sellers, and managers when shipping status changes (created, in transit, delivered, disputes).

data.name: [SEO] Category Meta Tags - Auto Generate
data.description: Creates SEO meta tags automatically when a new category is created.

data.name: [Swap] Offer Cancelled - Release Both Sides
data.description: When a swap offer is cancelled/rejected/expired: releases reserved stock on both sides of the swap.

data.name: Marketing Content / Enrichment Plan
data.description: Monthly. Picks the worst-covered approved brands, expands brand -> series -> models, and enqueues the work. Calls no model, so it is fast and safe to retry. The expensive half is the Drain flow below.

data.name: [Notify] New Contact - Notify Swibba Managers
data.description: Notifies all Swibba managers when a new contact request is submitted.

data.name: [Notify] Order Confirmed - Notify Buyer
data.description: Notifies the buyer when their order is confirmed.

data.name: Marketing Content / Alert Match
data.description: Listing transitions into published -> match confirmed catalog_alerts and create notifications. The status-transition guard is what stops every later edit re-notifying everyone. Docs: docs/content-as-marketing/07-availability-alerts.md section 3

data.name: [Social] Follow Created - Update Counts
data.description: When a user_follows record is created, updates followers_count and following_count on both users.

data.name: [Reviews] Review Deleted - Update User Rating
data.description: On review delete: recalculates the reviewed user’s rating and total_reviews.

data.name: [Cron] Listing Expiration Warning - Daily
data.description: Daily warning for listings expiring in 3-7 days (runs at 10:00 AM). Currently inactive.

data.name: [Store Team] New Review → Notify Managers
data.description: Additive: notifies store managers (business_team) on reviews items.create. Does not modify existing flows.

data.name: Marketing Content / Revalidate
data.description: Any catalog, content, geo or facet change -> purge the matching Next.js cache tags. Docs: docs/content-as-marketing/04-rendering-caching.md section 5

data.name: [Swap] Order Completed - Finalize Both Sides
data.description: When a swap order is completed: moves reserved to sold and updates listing status on both sides of the swap.

data.name: [Swap] Offer Created - Reserve Both Sides
data.description: When a swap offer is created: reserves stock on the target listing and the offered swap listings.

data.name: [Helper] Send Email Notification
data.description: Helper flow to send email notifications via SMTP

data.name: [Business] New Business Created - Notify Swibba Managers
data.description: When a new business is created during onboarding, notifies all Swibba managers with a deep link.

data.name: Marketing Content / Listing Supply
data.description: A listing changed -> purge the catalog counts and the indexation gate reads for its chain and its city. Docs: docs/content-as-marketing/04-rendering-caching.md section 5

data.name: Marketing Content / Revalidate Settings
data.description: catalog_content_settings change -> purge catalog:settings. Logs activity only, never the payload: the payload carries the marketing access key in plaintext. See 06-build-flows.mjs FLOW 2b.

data.name: Marketing Content / Generate (copy)
data.description: Catalog entity created or renamed -> generate landing-page content in all 7 languages. catalog_content* is deliberately NOT in the scope so the generator writeback cannot loop. Docs: docs/content-as-marketing/03-content-pipeline.md

data.name: [Notify] Order Completed - Notify Seller
data.description: Notifies the seller when an order is marked as completed.

data.name: [Notify] Listing Updated - Notify Watchers
data.description: Notifies users watching a listing when it is updated.

data.name: [Swap] Order Cancelled - Release Both Sides
data.description: When a swap order is cancelled or refunded: releases reserved stock on both sides of the swap.

data.name: [Cron] Auto-Complete Shipped Orders (7-Day Safety Valve)
data.description: Runs daily. Auto-completes orders shipped more than 7 days ago without buyer confirmation.

data.name: [Helper] Expire Single Offer
data.description: Helper: expires a single offer by ID. Triggered by Auto-Expire cron with iteration. The individual update triggers the existing Release Stock flow.

data.name: Marketing Content / Enrichment Drain
data.description: Every 10 minutes. Leases a few queue rows, generates them, ledgers the spend, releases the rest. Short on purpose: the route dies at 300s and one 7-locale node takes 20-70s, so a longer tick would be killed mid-node and leave a half-written translation set. Does nothing when no run is active.

data.name: [SEO] Listing Meta Tags - Auto Generate
data.description: Creates SEO meta tags for new listings based on listing content.

data.name: Marketing Content / Model Discovery
data.description: Monthly. Asks, per SERIES, which models released since are missing from the list we already hold - a checkable list-diff, not an open question. Writes catalog_candidates ONLY; promotion to a real models row is always a human decision.

data.name: [Cron] Auto-Expire Offers - Hourly
data.description: Runs hourly. Expires pending/countered offers past their expiry via [Helper] Expire Single Offer.

data.name: [Notify] New Message - Notify Recipient (All Types)
data.description: Notifies a user when they receive a new message (user-to-user, manager, system). Currently inactive - messaging notifications are handled in app code.

data.name: [Business] Listing Created by Manager - Reassign Owner
data.description: When a store manager creates a listing, reassigns listings.user_id to the store’s business owner so ownership stays with the business.

data.name: [Notify] Contact Form - Send Confirmation Email
data.description: Sends a confirmation/notification email to the user after a contact form submission.

data.name: [Orders] Order Cancelled - Revert Offers & Notify
data.description: When an order is cancelled: reverts linked accepted offers to cancelled (which triggers [Stock] Offer Cancelled/Expired - Release Reserved), cancels a linked rental row, and notifies the other party. Swap stock is handled by [Swap] flows.

data.name: [Notify] New Order - Notify Seller & Store Team
data.description: When a new order is created, notifies the business owner and the assigned store manager(s).

data.name: [Reviews] Store Rating - Recalculate
data.description: On review create/update with a store_id: recalculates the store’s rating and total_reviews.

data.name: [Helper] Create Notification
data.description: Reusable helper flow to create notifications with preference checking

data.name: [Deprecated] Order Cancelled by Business - Duplicate Stock Release
data.description: DEACTIVATED 2026-07-19: released reserved_quantity directly on every order cancellation (not only business ones, unclamped), duplicating the release already done via [Orders] Order Cancelled - Revert Offers -> [Stock] Offer Cancelled/Expired - Release Reserved. Kept inactive for reference.

data.name: [Notify] Offer Status Changed - Notify Offer Creator
data.description: Notifies the offer creator when their offer status changes.

data.name: [Helper] Send Push Notification
data.description: Helper flow to send push notifications via external service

data.name: [Social] Follow Deleted - Update Counts
data.description: When a user_follows record is deleted, updates followers_count and following_count on both users.

data.name: [Stock] Offer Cancelled/Expired - Release Reserved
data.description: When an offer becomes rejected/expired/withdrawn/cancelled: decrements reserved_quantity and restores the listing to published if stock is available again. Skips swaps ([Swap] flows) and untracked listings.

data.name: [Orders] Verification Events - Update Status
data.description: Updates order status when verification events are recorded (QR scans, handover confirmations).

data.name: [SEO] Next.js Cache Revalidator
data.description: Invalidates the Next.js cache when SEO-relevant content changes (global_seo, listings, listings_translations).

data.name: [Business] Document Re-submitted - Notify Swibba Managers
data.description: Notifies Swibba managers when a business re-submits a verification document.

data.name: [Notify] Order Ready for Pickup - Notify Buyer
data.description: Notifies the buyer when the seller marks an order as ready for pickup.

data.name: [Cron] Rental Expiration Reminder - Daily
data.description: Daily reminder for rentals expiring in 1-3 days (runs at 9:00 AM).

data.name: [Business] Store Approved/Rejected - Notify Owner
data.description: Notifies the business owner when their store is approved or rejected by a Swibba manager.

data.name: Marketing Content / Generate
data.description: Catalog entity created or renamed -> generate landing-page content in all 7 languages. catalog_content* is deliberately NOT in the scope so the generator writeback cannot loop. Docs: docs/content-as-marketing/03-content-pipeline.md

data.name: [SEO] AI GEO Autobuilder
data.description: Triggers OpenAI analysis on listing descriptions (listings_translations) to auto-build GEO/SEO metadata.

data.name: [Business] Document Rejected - Notify Owner
data.description: Notifies the business owner when one of their verification documents is rejected.

data.name: [Deprecated] Get Provider Info
data.description: Inactive/unfinished experiment: was meant to capture SSO provider info on user create; its only operation has a null payload.
